verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents an official Cloud MCP server. Through it, users can interact with clusters using natural-language prompts to list tables, execute statements, and insert rows, and AI tools can explore live schemas and run queries. This natural-language path requires an external AI client and is documented only for CockroachDB Cloud data and query operations, not broader cluster administration. missing for 10: natural-language control of cluster management (create/scale/backup), support beyond Cloud clusters, built-in NL interface without an external AI client, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: A user can interact with their clusters using natural language prompts to perform read and write operations such as listing tables, executing statements, and inserting rows into a table.
Your AI tools can explore live schemas and run queries against any cluster using OAuth or API key authentication.
